description: Wallet-level reputation for any address: LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH / UNKNOWN risk, registration source and indexed USDC activity. Use it for a raw wallet address; for an ERC-8004 agent use check_agent_trust (verdict) or get_trust_forensics (feedback analysis). Heuristic from on-chain registration plus indexed transfers — not an uptime SLA and not trading performance.
name: check_wallet_reputation
title: Wallet reputation
